summary_rationale: Alphabet exhibits elite structural business quality across two scaled compounding engines: Google Services ($342.7B FY2025 revenue, 40.7% operating margin; $96.3B Q3 2026 revenue, 40.7% margin) and Google Cloud ($58.7B FY2025 revenue, 23.7% margin, accelerating to $30.7B in Q3 2026 at +103% YoY and 36.2% operating margin with a $560.8B backlog). Consolidated ROIC stands at 28.67% with 60.86% gross margin and 32.0% FY2025 operating margin. Both U.S. federal antitrust trials (Search and AdTech) concluded with behavioral remedies rather than structural breakups. However, KPI health is rated PASS_WITH_WATCH due to five material watchpoints verified in the Q3 2026 10-Q and Nov 2026 filings: (1) CapEx surged to $131.9B in 9M 2026 ($195B–$205B guided for FY2026, with 2027 guided significantly higher), turning FCF negative in Q2 (-$5.86B) and Q3 2026 (-$9.07B); (2) off-balance-sheet long-term supply and energy commitments reached $802.1B alongside $29.5B Wiz and $5.9B Intersect M&A; (3) Alphabet reversed from net share repurchaser to major issuer ($30.5B June common + $18.0B 6.25% mandatory convertible preferred + $12.4B Q3 ATM, lifting Q3 diluted shares to 12,368M) while debt rose to $125.1B plus €6.0B Euro notes closed Nov 5, 2026; (4) European antitrust/DMA enforcement imposed $5.2B ECJ Android cash payment, $1.0B DMA fines, and $2.1B PriceRunner damages award; and (5) Alphabet-level shared AI R&D losses widened +71% YoY to -$7.66B and Other Bets losses hit -$2.05B in Q3 2026.
